# netbox_circuit (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/circuits/#circuits_1):

> A communications circuit represents a single physical link connecting exactly two endpoints, commonly referred to as its A and Z terminations. A circuit in NetBox may have zero, one, or two terminations defined. It is common to have only one termination defined when you don't necessarily care about the details of the provider side of the circuit, e.g. for Internet access circuits. Both terminations would likely be modeled for circuits which connect one customer site to another.
>
> Each circuit is associated with a provider and a user-defined type. For example, you might have Internet access circuits delivered to each site by one provider, and private MPLS circuits delivered by another. Each circuit must be assigned a circuit ID, each of which must be unique per provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_tenant" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_provider" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_type" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

resource "netbox_circuit" "test" {
  cid         = "test"
  status      = "active"
  provider_id = netbox_circuit_provider.test.id
  type_id     = netbox_circuit_type.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cid` (String) The circuit ID of the circuit.
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the provider associated with the circuit.
- `status` (String) Valid values are `planned`, `provisioning`, `active`, `offline`, `deprovisioning` and `decommissioning`.
- `type_id` (Number) The ID of the type associated with the circuit.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the circuit.
- `commit_rate` (Number) Committed rate.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the circuit.
- `distance` (Number) The distance of the circuit.
- `distance_unit` (String) One of [km, m, mi, ft].
- `install_date` (String) The installation date of the circuit, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the circuit. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `provider_account_id` (Number) The ID of the provider account associated with the circuit.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the circuit.
- `termination_date` (String) The termination date of the circuit, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the circuit was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the circuit was last changed.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.
- `termination_a_id` (Number) The ID of the termination a associated with the circuit.
- `termination_z_id` (Number) The ID of the termination z associated with the circuit.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_circuit.example 1
```
